verdict.rationale: Square's Catalog API (implied by MCP tool catalog spanning 'payments, checkout, catalog, inventory') and Invoices API support creating items, prices, and payment links programmatically, and the Square MCP server (local and OAuth-gated remote at mcp.squareup.com) gives agents direct API access to 'everything the APIs offer,' which would let an agent chain these calls in one session. However, no evidence pack item shows an actual end-to-end documented workflow or example of creating a product+price+payment link together, and no Checkout/Payment Links API doc is explicitly cited. missing for 10: a documented Payment Links or Checkout API endpoint, an explicit example/tutorial chaining catalog item + price + link creation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent completing this multi-step flow in one session.
